title: Marta G NDE 4160
content: I was only five and could not swim. I got out too deep to stand up and struggled to swim or get back to standing depth. Eventually I could no longer move a hand or foot and could only surrender to the water. I recall my eyes open, how beautiful the particles in the lake were and how peaceful I felt knowing I was not capable of moving an inch or doing anything else but surrender. I slowly breathed in the water and immediately lost consciousness. A beautiful woman dressed in bright white light pulled me out and, looking into my eyes, asked me what I wanted. I was completely satisfied and could think of nothing until it occurred to me to take a trip around the lake. I did and saw detail I would ever have seen in 'real' life. I could go anywhere, even to the tops of trees, by simply intending to do so. I went out to the dock where the big kids dived off and was surprised to find it empty. All the kids and adults were on the side of the lake congregating around something or someone on the ground. I wasn't interested and wanted to continue exploring when I suddenly knew I had to go, right now! It was as if someone was calling me but could not be ignored and it was not a voice per se. The next thing I knew I saw this woman's back (bathing cap, hair sticking out, bathing suit straps, large mole on back) with her mouth on a girl on the sand. The next thing I knew, I was suddenly in my body and it was incredibly heavy and ached. After lots of coaxing, I opened my eyes and everything swirled around me. People were talking loudly and it was all very confusing and too much. I passed out and woke up several days later.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Traveled around the lake and to the tops of trees by intending to do so.

arrival.other_being_detail: A beautiful woman dressed in bright white light who pulled her out and asked what she wanted.

environment.environment_other_detail: Noted beautiful particles in the lake; saw details around the lake she would not have seen in real life; could go to tops of trees by intention.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in a lake (age five, could not swim).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed resuscitation scene: saw a woman's back with mouth on a girl on the sand; then returned to body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel or distinct otherworldly realm; experience involved OBE around the lake after being pulled out by a woman in bright white light, then an urgent call to return and immediate re-entry into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The initial peaceful perception of lake particles while drowning; being asked by a woman in bright white light what she wanted; traveling around the physical lake by intention; non-voice 'calling' that could not be ignored; detailed observation of a woman performing mouth-to-mouth on the girl.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “A beautiful woman dressed in bright white light pulled me out and, looking into my eyes, asked me what I wanted.”
